# $orderby and $expand are validated, then change nothing

**Claim.** `$orderby=CreatedDate desc` and `$expand=noteDetails` both pass validation and both return a body identical to the plain request — the sort never reorders and the expand never populates `contactHistory`. Values outside the accepted sets are refused with INVALID_PARAMETER, so the parameters are checked strictly and then ignored.

Applies to: `~1people~1{vanId}~1notes/get`

## Observed exchange

_A person with one note to list._

```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Prudence",
  "lastName": "Ashby-{scope}"
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```
```http
(setup) POST /people/100000001/notes

{
  "text": "Interested in canvassing.",
  "isViewRestricted": false
}

→ 204
```
```http
GET /people/100000001/notes

→ 200
{
  "items": [
    {
      "contactHistory": null,
      "noteId": 100000002,
      "text": "Interested in canvassing.",
      "isViewRestricted": false,
      "category": {
        "noteCategoryId": 0,
        "name": null
      },
      "createdDate": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "isPinned": false
    }
  ],
  "nextPageLink": null,
  "count": 1
}
```

_Descending sort: accepted, and the body comes back identical to the plain call._

```http
GET /people/100000001/notes?%24orderby=CreatedDate+desc

→ 200
{
  "items": [
    {
      "contactHistory": null,
      "noteId": 100000002,
      "text": "Interested in canvassing.",
      "isViewRestricted": false,
      "category": {
        "noteCategoryId": 0,
        "name": null
      },
      "createdDate": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "isPinned": false
    }
  ],
  "nextPageLink": null,
  "count": 1
}
```

_The one accepted $expand value: also identical, contactHistory still null._

```http
GET /people/100000001/notes?%24expand=noteDetails

→ 200
{
  "items": [
    {
      "contactHistory": null,
      "noteId": 100000002,
      "text": "Interested in canvassing.",
      "isViewRestricted": false,
      "category": {
        "noteCategoryId": 0,
        "name": null
      },
      "createdDate": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "isPinned": false
    }
  ],
  "nextPageLink": null,
  "count": 1
}
```

_Anything outside the accepted sets is refused, not ignored._

```http
GET /people/100000001/notes?%24orderby=Text

→ 400
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "INVALID_PARAMETER",
      "text": "'Text' is not a valid argument for the '$orderby' parameter",
      "properties": [
        "$orderby"
      ],
      "hint": "The only valid orderby properties are: 'CreatedDate', 'IsPinned'"
    }
  ]
}
```
```http
GET /people/100000001/notes?%24expand=contactHistory

→ 400
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "INVALID_PARAMETER",
      "text": "'contactHistory' is not a valid argument for the '$expand' parameter",
      "properties": [
```
